kind: ZoneLockdown

| `forProvider.configurations[].target` | string | yes | `ip` for an IP address, `ip_range` for a /16 or /24 range. One of `ip`, `ip_range`. |

| `forProvider.paused` | boolean |  | When true, indicates that the rule is currently paused. |
| `forProvider.priority` | integer (int64) |  | The priority of the rule to control the processing order. A lower number indicates higher priority. If not provided, any rules with a configured priority will be processed before rules without a priority. |
| `forProvider.urls` | []string | yes | The URLs to include in the current WAF override. You can use wildcards. Each entered URL will be escaped before use, which means you can only use simple wildcard patterns. |
| `forProvider.zoneRef` | object |  | A reference to another managed resource: a namespaced resource in the namespace of the resource holding the reference, or a cluster-scoped one. |
